background: The Goldman Sachs Group is the holding company of the leading US investment bank, earning from advisory, trading and asset and wealth management, with a smaller lending and deposit franchise than the universal banks.
synthesis: Rated A- on average across all three, the weakest of them at BBB+, with one on a positive outlook and two on stable, the group's last rating move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 27 Jan 2021. CET1 of 13.6% is above the US bank median, but leverage of 4.3% is in the bottom quarter, the usual mark of a trading-heavy balance sheet and the figure to watch. Both have fallen since 30 Jun 2025, CET1 by 1.7 points and leverage by 1.0 points, while LCR of 126% sits above the median and has held broadly flat. The only flagged item is second-quarter earnings on 14 Jul 2026.
